reponse: The Go-Live Date is December 7, 2026, subject to the customer completing KYC data and webhook certification five business days before [1]. If Production is unavailable by then for reasons attributable to Quillon, the customer receives service credits of 5% of monthly Platform Fees per full week of delay, capped at 25%, as its sole remedy [1]. Tomer Golan owns the Tradewell cutover end to end [2]; Ellen is the owner on the customer side [2].
